errors.error_description: Inserted a missing semicolon at the end of the localparam declaration line to violate basic syntax rules.
Used always_ff with an additional asynchronous event (posedge req_valid) that is not a reset, improperly mixing asynchronous control with synchronous logic.
Mixed blocking and non-blocking assignments to the same sequential register within a clocked always_ff block by using a blocking assignment to resp_valid_q.
